metricDefinitions.event_amplitude_snr: 95th-percentile peak amplitude divided by the successive-difference noise floor, std(diff(f))/sqrt(2).
metricDefinitions.frac_events_gt4sd: Fraction of detected events exceeding 4 SD of the non-event baseline of the raw trace.
metricDefinitions.percentile_range_snr: (P95 - P50) of dF/F divided by the MAD-SD of the residual after Gaussian smoothing.
